description: Zenith service.status: systemctl show for one unit. Read-only. Output format zenith.service.status/v1.

unit.description: systemd unit name ending in .service, .socket or .timer.

executionTimeout.description: Seconds before the command is considered failed (1-999).

runCommand: [ -n "$unit" ] || die 64 'parameter unit is empty (SSM Agent >= 3.3.2746.0 is required for ENV_VAR parameters)'
case "$unit" in -*|*[!A-Za-z0-9@._:-]*) die 64 'invalid unit name' ;; esac
case "$unit" in *.service|*.socket|*.timer) ;; *) die 64 'invalid unit name' ;; esac
command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 69 'systemctl is not available on this machine'
[ -d /run/systemd/system ] || die 69 'systemd is not running on this machine'
